title: The Signature Canon of the Paired Hearts
summary: A school canon in which two students or two hearts keep one duet of pulses and end in a single school move for the pair.

title: A Twin-Court Signature Treatise on Open Veins
summary: A school treatise on opening the veins of the user in a chosen order to loose a flood of blood-qi and end in the school's fountain.

title: The Hawk's Signature Book of Red Wings
summary: A school book of the hawk's dive that keeps the sharpest sense and the hardest stoop of the blood tradition for its senior students.

title: The Dual-Track Signature of the Great Beat
summary: A school signature for those with a formed Core that runs one slow vast beat on the second track beneath the pulse.

title: A Windward Signature Book of Running Blood
summary: A school book of the running pulse that rides the wind and ends in the school move taught to every wind-sworn runner of the blood.

title: The Signature Reckoning of the True Bearing
summary: A school reckoning that fixes a bearing in the pulse and holds it true through every swerve to end in the school's unerring blow.

title: A Wind-Sworn Signature Canon of the Open Heart
summary: A school canon of the open chest that fights without a wall and gives back every blow with a sworn and unguarded heart.

title: The Oath-Signature of the Storm Pulse
summary: A school signature for the Core-formed wind-sworn that binds a storm to the pulse by oath and releases it in the school move.
